sentences.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
sentences.zh: 菜单上的菜肴种类繁多。

sentences.en: Susan broke the dish on purpose to show her anger.
sentences.zh: 苏珊故意摔碎了盘子以表示她的愤怒。

sentences.en: A nice roast chicken is one of my favorite dishes.
sentences.zh: 美味的烤鸡是我最喜欢的一道菜之一。

senses.zh: 盘；餐具；一盘食物；外貌有吸引力的人
